feeds.title: Fraud of the Day
feeds.description: Fraud of the Day shines a light through daily articles on egregious fraudsters and the dedicated work by federal, state, and local government agencies to stop their unlawful activities and make sure justice is served. We raise awareness of these fraudulent cases on a daily basis across a variety of government programs.

feeds.description: Fraud Intelligence is the leading practical resource for the counter-fraud professional; it provides applied insight, analysis and tools to combat fraud and corruption, whether in the corporate or non-commercial sector, together with coverage of relevant statute and case law.

feeds.title: Sequence Inc
feeds.description: Commentary on fraud, scams, scandals, and court cases. Tracy Coenen is a forensic accountant and fraud investigator specializing in corporate fraud, litigation, and lifestyle analysis for divorce cases.

feeds.title: Mortgage Fraud Blog
feeds.description: Rachel Dollar, the editor of Mortgage Fraud Blog is a California attorney and Certified Mortgage Banker who handles litigation for mortgage lenders, servicers, and financial institutions. My mission is to raise awareness about the significant issues caused by mortgage fraud.

feeds.title: Serious Fraud Office
feeds.description: SFO press releases, official statements, and speech transcripts are published here, along with an archive of previously published news. The SFO is a specialist prosecuting authority tackling the top level of serious or complex fraud, bribery and corruption. We are part of the UK criminal justice system covering England, Wales and Northern Ireland.

feeds.title: Leonard W. Vona Blog
